They stand on a sidewalk next to a road with moving cars, pointing towards a vertical gym sign on a building. The lighting is bright natural daylight. One host holds a yellow and blue branded microphone. (2) A vertical sign for a gym is shown in a close-up shot, followed by a cut back to the hosts who are laughing and talking. The background shows a white building with large glass windows and some parked vehicles. (3) The scene transitions to the interior of a gym. A male staff member in a striped sweater and a female owner in a beige long-sleeve top are interviewed at a reception desk. The background is filled with weights, workout machines, and shelves of supplements. (4) The male staff member removes his sweater to reveal a highly muscular, tanned physique, posing with his arms flexed. The hosts react with wide eyes and open mouths. The lighting shifts to bright indoor studio-style lights, highlighting the definition of his muscles.
